description: Urban Science is a University of Wisconsin–Madison epistemic-game programme that engages learners in individual and collaborative urban-redevelopment planning through professional-practicum-like tasks and deliverables.
title: Urban Science

description: Uro-Island is a Windows-based electronic adventure game developed at the University Medical Center Freiburg for teaching medical students phase-contrast microscopic urinalysis through story-driven exploration, dialogue, quests, and diagnosis.
title: Uro-Island
